service.description:
What a user (the current user by default; another user only with authorization disabled) may do in a drive, and at a path when one is given (a share of the path or a folder above it counts): level 0 none, 1 view, 2 edit, 3 manage; canWrite (edit level on a drive that is not read only); canUpload (canWrite, or an upload-only share); viaShareId when a share gave the level. drive is the drive's fields with its storage (folder, git-db, git-local, git-remote), readOnly, and its repository's kind, branch, head and fetch state. With no user and authorization disabled (a job), or internal with authorization disabled (a public link's file drop, which checked its token), the level is manage.
A records drive (driveKindEnumId RdkRecords): below the manage level, a path (the drive's top included) must be in the drive's folder map and in records the user may see (check#RecordPaths: the record visibility hook, each record asked once per request; with no hook no record folder is reached), else the level is 0, as for a path outside the drive; a share of the path does not pass it either. Another user's records are not asked (level 0 below manage). recordList is the records the path is in, innermost first (recordEntityName, idField, recordId, folderPath of the record's own folder), for a manager too. Without a path the level is the drive's. An external user (the framework permission EXTERNAL_USER) reaches no records drive at all: level 0, whatever their membership, share or ownership.

For a records drive (driveKindEnumId RdkRecords), where each path (path, or pathList) is in its folder map (its ResourceDriveRecordFolder rows) and whether the current user may see it. mapped: the drive's top, a mapped folder, a step on the way to a pattern such as asset/*/maintenance, or anything below one; any other path (the trash folder too) is not. records: the records the path is in, innermost first (each mapped folder the path goes below names the record of its next segment: recordEntityName, idField, recordId, and folderPath, the record's own folder). visible (with checkVisible, the default): mapped, and each of those records one the user may see as the record visibility hook answers (org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.check#RecordVisible: the service the user's theme names in STRT_RECORD_VISIBLE_SERVICE, called as the user with checkOnly; with no such theme value no record is visible, logged once), each record asked once per execution context (one request). With no user, only authorization disabled sees the records. It says nothing about membership: get#DriveAccess calls it below the manage level, and so do the lists across a records drive. Another kind of drive: isRecords false and each path visible; no drive: nothing visible.

parameter.name: pathInfoList
parameter.description: {path, mapped, visible, records}, in the order given

parameter.name: folderList
parameter.description: The folder map: folderPath, recordEntityName, idField, label

service.description: The user's personal drive (the current user's; another user's only with authorization disabled), made the first time it is asked for on the database tree under the moqui.drive.root preference (dbresource://drive by default) at personal/userId.

A shared drive of the current user (its owner). storage: folder (the database tree, each file with its own versions; the default), gitDb (a git repository in the database), gitLocal (a bare git repository on disk that can be cloned), or mirror (admins only: a read-only mirror of remoteUrl, fetched on its interval by the fetch_AllGitRepositories_frequent job). A records drive (driveKindEnumId RdkRecords) or any explicit rootLocation is for admins or internal setup (authorization disabled). memberList holds maps of userId or userGroupId with a permissionEnumId (RdpView by default).
Change a drive's name, description and quota; for a mirror its URL, credentials (an empty accessToken leaves it) and fetch interval. Manage permission.
Archive a drive (read only, left out of the user's list), or with archived false bring it back. Manage permission; a personal drive is not archived.
Let a user or a user group open a drive with RdpView, RdpEdit or RdpManage; a current member row of the same user or group gets the new permission. Manage permission; not on a personal drive.
End a drive membership (thruDate now): by driveMemberId, or the current rows of a userId or userGroupId. Manage permission.
The current members of a drive the user may open, with their names. View permission.

The drives the current user may open: the personal drive (made on first use) first, then owned and member drives by name, each with the user's level and permission, its quota, member count and storage. Archived drives only with includeArchived. The bytes used (usedBytes) only with includeUsage, as sizing a drive reads every file row or tree under it: null otherwise, for a records drive (a walk of every record's files) unless includeRecordsUsage too, and when the drive's storage cannot be read (logged). A screen that shows the usage of one drive asks get#DriveUsage when it shows it.

The bytes the files of drives use, for a quota bar shown when it is needed rather than on every list: driveId, or driveIdList. usageList has driveId, usedBytes (null when the storage cannot be read, which is logged), quotaBytes and usedPercent (with a quota). View permission; a records drive (its total is a walk of every record's files) for its managers only. A drive the user cannot reach is left out.

A copy of a drive: a git drive in the database as a bare repository on disk (GitServices.export#GitRepository, exportPath), a git drive on disk is already one (its path), a folder drive as a zip (exportLocation, under runtime/tmp/drive-export unless targetLocation is given). Manage permission.

The entries of a folder of a drive: name, path, isDirectory, size, modified (milliseconds) and modifiedByUserId with modifiedByName (on a git drive the commit that last changed the entry, from the path index; on the database tree the file's current version), versionName and versionNote, shared, favorite (the current user's), tags, contentType and fileType; folders first, then by name. On a records drive the top level is its ResourceDriveRecordFolder map (label, recordEntityName), and the record folders below a mapped folder carry recordEntityName, idField and recordId; of the record folders of a mapped folder the newest recordLimit are listed, at every level, a manager's too (moreRecordCount is how many more there are, neither asked nor listed: open a record's folder by its path, or search), and below the manage level only those in records the user may see (check#RecordPaths). folder.recordList is the records the folder is in, innermost first. The drive's hidden trash folder and .gitkeep files are left out. View permission on the drive, or a share of the folder.

One file or folder of a drive with what list#Folder shows of it, its location (for a download through the resource facade, with #versionName for a past version: getLocationReference(location).openStream() and ec.web.sendResourceResponse read that version), and whether it may be compared (text). recordList: on a records drive the records the path is in, innermost first. Records the open in the user's recent files when opened is true. View permission on the drive, or a share of the path.

Files and folders by name (and later their extracted text) across the drives the user may open, or one drive (driveId) and folder (path, and below it): filters fileType (image, pdf, text, document, spreadsheet, presentation, video, audio, archive, folder, other), modifiedFrom and modifiedThru (milliseconds) or modifiedPeriod (day, week, month, year), tagId, and modifiedByUserId. Through the MoquiDriveFile search document when search is available (usedIndex true), else a walk of the folders that stops at 5000 entries per drive. On a records drive below the manage level only what is in records the user may see (check#RecordPaths; the walk does not go into the others). Newest first, at most limit.
The current user's recently opened or changed files across the drives they may still open, newest first: the ResourceRecent rows written by uploads, writes and opens, each still there.

Upload files into a folder of a drive as one change set (one commit on a git drive) with an optional version note: fileList (uploaded files, or streams such as ref.openStream()) or file, each named by its file name, or by relativePathList (a folder upload, or the names of streams: the same order, paths under the folder); an item that is not a file or a stream fails. conflictPolicy for a name already there: replace (the storage keeps the replaced version), keepBoth (the new file gets "name (2).ext"), or skip. Refused whole when the drive would pass its quota. uploadedList has each file's name, path and outcome (created, replaced, renamed, skipped, failed with error). Edit permission, or an upload-only share (then names never replace).

parameter.name: asInternal
parameter.description: For upload#PublicShare, which checked its link: the drive's access is not checked. Only with authorization disabled.

service.description: Write a text file of a drive (a new note, or an edit) with a version note. Edit permission.
A new folder in a folder of a drive (on a git drive with a .gitkeep, as git keeps no empty folder). Edit permission.
Internal: after a move or rename, the shares, favorites, tags and recent rows of a path and everything under it follow it to the new path. Authorization must be disabled.
Rename a file or folder in place; its shares, favorites and tags follow it. Edit permission.

Move files and folders (path, or pathList) into a folder (toPath) of the same drive as one change set (one commit on a git drive), their shares, favorites and tags following; or into another drive (toDriveId) as a copy and a trash of the source, the history staying with the source drive. A name already in the target is refused for that item (keepBoth gives it a free name instead). movedList has each item's path, newPath and outcome. Edit permission on both.

Copy files and folders (path, or pathList) into a folder (toPath) of the same drive or another (toDriveId), as one change set in the target. A name already there gets a free name ("name (2).ext") with conflictPolicy keepBoth (the default), else that item is refused. copiedList has each item's path, newPath and outcome. View permission on the source, edit on the target.

Move files and folders (path, or pathList) to the drive's trash as one change set: on the database tree each moves, with its history, into the drive's hidden trash folder (.trash/trashId/name); on a git drive each is deleted in one commit, its ResourceTrash.versionName the version before the delete (restore writes it back). trashList has each item's path, trashId and outcome. Edit permission.
The items in a drive's trash, newest first; on a records drive below the manage level only those of records the user may see. View permission on the drive.

Bring an item back from the trash to the path it had: on the database tree it moves back with its history; on a git drive the version before the delete is written back in one commit (a folder with everything under it). Refused while something else is at that path. Edit permission.
Delete an item of the trash for good: on the database tree its trash copy and its history; on a git drive the trash row (the file stays in the drive's history). Edit permission.
Delete every item of a drive's trash for good (delete#TrashForever of each; one that fails is reported and the others go). Edit permission.
A file's versions, newest first: versionName, shortName (a git commit id's first 10 digits), previousVersionName, versionDate (milliseconds), userId with userName, note, isCurrent. View permission.

The line diff of a text file from one version to another (an empty name is the current text): the resource facade's getVersionDiff, {fromName, toName, unifiedDiff, html (a moqui-diff table), stats, hunks}. View permission; refused for a binary file.
Write a past version of a file back as its newest version (history is never rewritten), with a version note ("Restored version x" when none is given). Edit permission.

Share a file or folder with a user (sharedWithUserId), a user group, a party, an email address, or by link (isLink Y): permissionEnumId RspView (the default), RspEdit, or RspUpload (a folder only: a file drop), with an optional expireDate, password (links; kept only as its hash) and note. A link's token is returned once (linkToken, and linkPath /s/token for the public page); only its hash is kept. Edit permission.
End a share or link now (revokedDate). Its creator, or a manager of the drive.
Accept a share made to the current user (or one of their groups, or their party).
Decline a share made to the current user: it no longer grants access or shows as incoming.

The current user's shares: outgoingList (made by the user, or on drives they manage, to people), linkList (links, the same way; a link's token is never shown again), incomingList (made to the user, one of their groups or their party: current, with acceptedDate or declinedDate). With driveId and path, only the shares of that item. Revoked and expired shares are left out unless includeEnded.
Star (favorite true) or unstar a file or folder for the current user. View permission.
The current user's starred files and folders in drives they may still open.

Set the current user's tags on a file or folder to tagNameList (names; a new name makes a tag of the user's own): tags the user sees (their own and everyone's) that are not named are taken off. View permission.
The tags the current user sees: their own and everyone's, by name.

A zip of files and folders of a drive (path, or pathList; the drive's top folder when neither), written to runtime://tmp/drive-zip for the caller to send (zipLocation, zipFilename: send it with ec.web.sendResourceResponse(zipLocation, false, zipFilename); clean#DriveTempFiles removes it after a day). A file that cannot be read is left out and reported; on a records drive below the manage level the folders of records the user may not see are left out. View permission.

What happened to a file or folder, newest first: its versions (on a git drive every commit under the path, with the paths it changed), its shares and links made and revoked, and trash. Each row: action (version, share, link, revoke, trash), date, userId with userName, note, versionName, paths. On a records drive below the manage level, a row with a path outside the records the user may see is left out. View permission.

A preview of a file, kept under runtime://tmp/preview by the file's version and size so it is made once (a new version gets a new one): an image's thumbnail (PNG, no side over size: previewLocation, width, height); a PDF's page 1 drawn by the PDF engine (the same, with pages, the page count; no image and no error when there is no engine); a spreadsheet's first 100 rows and 26 columns of sheetName, else the first sheet (rows, sheetNames, sheetName, truncated); a text file its first 4000 characters (text). kind is image, pdf, spreadsheet, text or none. Records the open in the user's recent files. View permission. No transaction, so no connection is held while the PDF engine works.

Remove the temporary files of drives older than maxAgeHours (a day by default): the zips of download#Zip and download#PublicShare (runtime://tmp/drive-zip), the exports export#Drive leaves there (drive-export), the previews of get#Preview (runtime://tmp/preview, made again when next asked for), the extracted text of extract#DriveFileText (runtime://tmp/file-text, extracted again when next indexed) and any other runtime://tmp/drive-* folder an application keeps copies in, with the folders they leave empty. A file that cannot be removed is logged and the others go on. The clean_DriveTempFiles_hourly ServiceJob runs it.

Internal: index the MoquiDriveFile search documents of paths of a drive (a folder with everything under it, up to 2000 entries) and remove those of removePathList (and everything under them). The extractedText of a PDF, spreadsheet or text file comes from the text cache only (ec.resource.extractText); up to 200 files not in it yet go to extract#DriveFileText, run asynchronously, which fills the cache and indexes them again (with extractMissing false). Nothing happens without search; a failure is logged and the caller goes on. Authorization must be disabled.

Internal, run asynchronously by index#DriveFiles: extract the text of the files of pathList in a drive (PDF through the PDF engine, spreadsheets, text files) into the text cache (ec.resource.extractText), then index those paths again so their documents carry it. A file that cannot be read is logged, cached as having no text, and the others go on. No transaction, so no connection is held while the PDF engine works. It returns no text.

Internal, after a fetch of a mirror (the GitServices fetch SECAs): index the paths that changed since each drive over the repository was last indexed (ResourceDrive indexedVersionName; the whole drive the first time), and remove those no longer there. A drive that fails is logged and the others go on.

The token check of the /s/token route (the token-route in MoquiConf): valid when the token names a link that is not revoked or expired. routeContext is what the public page may show: the item's name, whether it is a folder, the permission, whether a password is needed, the sharer's name, the note and the expiry. Nothing else is read for a bad token.

Open a link: the token is checked first (a bad, revoked or expired one is "not found" and nothing more is read), then the password when the link has one. Gives a short-lived grant (an hour) that list#PublicShare, download#PublicShare and upload#PublicShare take with the token, and counts the opening (openedCount, lastOpenedDate). share is what check#PublicShareToken shows.

The files of a shared folder (path below it), or the shared file itself: name, path (relative to the share), isDirectory, size, modified, contentType. The token is checked first, then the grant of open#PublicShare when the link has a password. An upload-only link lists nothing (uploadOnly true).

A file of a share to send (location, fileName, contentType), or for a folder (path empty: the whole share) a zip of it (location under runtime://tmp/drive-zip). The token is checked first, then the grant when the link has a password. Refused for an upload-only link.
The visitor of a public page has no user, and a file on the database tree is entity rows the visitor may not read, so a token route's transition does not send the location itself: with sendResponse true this service writes the response (ec.web.sendResourceResponse, named fileName, Cache-Control private), reading the file under its own anonymous-all authorization after the token and grant checks. With inline true a picture (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP) or a PDF is shown in the page; anything else is an attachment. Nothing is sent after an error: the transition sends its own answer then.

A file drop through a link with RspUpload or RspEdit permission on a folder: the files (fileList or file) go into the shared folder (path below it) as one change set, a name already there gets a free name, and the version note names the uploader (uploaderName). The token is checked first, then the grant when the link has a password; the drive's quota applies.
